idea-plugin.name: Lettras
idea-plugin.description:
Insert word searches and sudokus, and write selected text in 22 Unicode styles that keep accents (bold, italic, script, fraktur, circled, strikethrough...). Six languages: Spanish, English, Portuguese, French, German and Italian. The engine runs locally inside the IDE: no network, no API key.
  • Tools > Lettras > Write Selection in a Unicode Style
  • Tools > Lettras > Insert a Word Search
  • Tools > Lettras > Insert a Sudoku

action.text: Write Selection in a Unicode Style
action.description: Replace the selected text with a Unicode style that keeps accents
Insert a word search with your words at the caret
Insert a sudoku with one solution at the caret
